tests.name: test_exact_duplicates_collapse
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id = 1) = 1 AS ok FROM deduped_events

tests.name: test_five_second_gap_is_duplicate_six_is_not
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id = 2) = 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id IN (3, 13)) = 2 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id = 7) = 0 AS ok FROM deduped_events

tests.name: test_same_timestamp_keeps_lowest_event_id
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id = 4) = 1 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id IN (5, 11)) = 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id = 10) = 1 AS ok FROM deduped_events

tests.name: test_dedup_key_includes_event_type
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id = 4) = 1 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id = 3) = 1 AS ok FROM deduped_events

tests.name: test_deduped_events_exact
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT event_id, user_id, item_id, event_type, event_ts FROM deduped_events), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, e2, e3, e4 FROM (VALUES (1, 1, 10, 'impression', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 10:00:00'), (3, 1, 10, 'impression', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 10:00:11'), (4, 1, 10, 'click', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 10:00:12'), (6, 2, 11, 'impression', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 11:00:00'), (13, 2, 11, 'impression', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 11:00:10'), (8, 2, NULL, 'click', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 11:00:30'), (9, NULL, 13, 'click', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 12:00:00'), (10, 3, 13, 'impression', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 12:00:01')) v(e0, e1, e2, e3, e4)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok

tests.name: test_never_clicked_survives_null_user_clicks
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT user_id FROM never_clicked), e AS (SELECT e0 FROM (VALUES (3), (4)) v(e0)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok

tests.name: test_items_without_clicks_requires_impression_and_survives_null_items
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT item_id FROM items_without_clicks), e AS (SELECT e0 FROM (VALUES (11)) v(e0)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok
